title: Nasruddin's Will
summary: Nasruddin dictated his last will: "To the village elder, I leave my empty purse, that he may learn humility. To the greedy moneylender, I leave my broken wooden shovel, that he may...
full_text: Nasruddin dictated his last will: "To the village elder, I leave my empty purse, that he may learn humility. To the greedy moneylender, I leave my broken wooden shovel, that he may dig for honest living. And to the world, I leave my jokes, that men may laugh and remember that life is a fleeting dream!"
moral: Leave behind laughter and goodwill; gold only incites disputes among heirs.
